value.rationale: This supplies the naturally motivated, previously unquantified distribution of eventual equilibria when initial gamete compositions are sampled uniformly. The complete non-Beta formula and the sharp \(1/\kappa\) rare-selection boundary law distinguish symmetric and asymmetric mixing; neither is read off from the preexisting fixed-point classification. It is an exact invariant selection law rather than an arbitrary slice or a restatement of deterministic convergence.
